ModMetaData.name: Planetsmith Test Runner
ModMetaData.author: aspctt
ModMetaData.description:
Development tool for Planetsmith. When the game is started with -planetsmithtest, it generates the worlds listed in the test job, writes their statistics to a file and closes the game. Without that argument it does nothing.
It runs against the test build the test script installs as aspctt.planetsmith.testbuild, so it declares no dependency on Planetsmith's own id.
